2607.26344.title: Automorphism-Induced Non-Canonicity in Top-k Explanations of Graph Neural Networks
2607.26344.paper_summary: A gradient-based GNN explainer given a molecule with two chemically equivalent nitro groups assigns them attribution scores that are equal to the last bit. It cannot do otherwise: message passing is exactly permutation equivariant, so any automorphism of the input leaves every attribution invariant. Yet the standard report, the top-k edges, names one of the two, and which one is settled by the order of an array. We show this is a structural obstruction rather than an implementation slip. When no minimal valid explanation is fixed by the input's automorphism group, no rule can be single-valued, minimal and symmetry-respecting at once. For the exact-k reports used in practice we give a parameter-free criterion, mechanised in Lean 4 with no axiom dependencies, that decides from the graph alone whether every score-optimal report of that size must split an orbit. Across 21298 instance-budget decisions the criterion agrees with a mechanical model-equivalence check without exception, and no severing case we found admitted a neutral alternative. The obstruction is common. Nontrivial automorphisms occur in 93.4% of Mutagenicity, the dataset the seminal explainability papers use, so the measure-zero dismissal of symmetric inputs, sound on the continuous domains it was made for, collapses here. At the sparsity budget those papers report, 24.0% of molecules with two interchangeable nitro groups (6 of 25) surface exactly one of them, every one arbitrary under mechanical verification. A model's blindness also manufactures symmetry: every MUTAG molecule contains atoms chemistry separates and the network provably cannot, and a matched control shows the resolution is set by what the model reads rather than how it is parameterised. Reporting orbits removes the arbitrariness at 0.11 ms and 0.43 extra edges per graph.
2607.26344.paper_summary_zh: 一個基於梯度的 GNN 解釋器在給定一個具有兩個化學等價的硝基團的分子時，為它們分配的歸因分數等於最後一位。它無法做其他的：消息傳遞恰好是置換等變的，因此輸入的任何自同構都會使每個歸因保持不變。然而，標準報告，即 top-k 邊，命名了其中一個，而哪一個則由數組的順序決定。我們表明這是一種結構性障礙，而不是實施上的失誤。當沒有最小有效解釋由輸入的自同構群固定時，沒有任何規則可以同時是單值的、最小的和尊重對稱的。對於實踐中使用的 exact-k 報告，我們提供了一個無參數的標準，並在 Lean 4 中機械化，沒有公理依賴，這可以僅根據圖決定每個該大小的分數最佳報告是否必須分裂一個軌道。在 21298 個實例預算決策中，該標準與機械模型等價檢查一致，沒有例外，且我們找到的沒有任何切斷情況承認中立的替代方案。這種障礙是普遍存在的。在 93.4% 的 Mutagenicity 中發生非平凡自同構，這是開創性解釋性論文使用的數據集，因此對對稱輸入的零測度棄置在這裡崩潰。在這些論文報告的稀疏預算下，24.0% 的具有兩個可互換硝基團的分子（25 個中的 6 個）恰好顯示其中一個，根據機械驗證，每一個都是任意的。一個模型的盲點也製造了對稱：每個 MUTAG 分子都包含化學分開的原子，而網絡可證明無法做到，且一個匹配的對照顯示解決方案是由模型所讀取的內容而不是它的參數化方式所設定的。報告軌道在每個圖上以 0.11 毫秒和 0.43 額外邊去除了隨意性。
